slice: Add an independent fail-closed verifier for the generated commit-bound audio-routing evidence packet and wire it into CI before artifact acceptance.

verification.source_writes: confirmed by GitHub contents API commits

falsification_route: A packet with a failed browser regression must be rejected even if verification_passed is manually set true.
A packet bound to a different commit must be rejected.
A packet that removes the physical-speaker limitation must be rejected.
A valid exact-commit packet with all required outcomes successful must pass.
limits: No GitHub Actions run result or uploaded artifact was observable during this run.
The verifier checks evidence structure and binding, not physical speaker emission or listener perception.
Vercel did not deploy the commit because the project reports a build-rate-limit failure.
